_comment: Paste into GLOBAL ~/.claude/settings.json only. Never into a project .claude/ folder, so the alarm never ships with your code. Repeat count is NOT set here: the CLI reads ~/.config/ai-agent-bell/config.json at runtime (ai-agent-bell config --times N). Requires: npm i -g ai-agent-bell (once per machine). NOTE: Stop fires per response/turn, not per whole task. StopFailure covers API-error turns.
